choice.basis: The state risk dashboard (chart) uses a color scale where darker red indicates higher risk. New Mexico (NM) is shaded in the darkest red, indicating the highest risk index among the options. Rhode Island (RI) is also dark red but less intense than NM. Delaware (DE) is orange, indicating lower risk. The task requires selecting the highest-risk state for priority follow-up, which aligns with New Mexico (NM).
choice.option_label: Open New Mexico (NM) risk detail for priority follow-up
